sources.quote: And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone's qualification is conditional, as stated at the 2026-10-02 board. Nothing later in the documents lifts that. Moving BR-310 deliveries to a new receiving plant (Beinasco) is new business for this supplier.

sources.quote:
cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier; found at incoming inspection on BR-310.

findings.why: The supplier has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material, and it was found on BR-310 itself. The root cause is still under investigation and the corrective action is not verified.

sources.quote: BR-310 brackets from Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) may be packed 40 per layer

findings.why: No controlled release record is in the documents for BR-310 from Chisone at Beinasco (PLT-BEI), for any customer. DEV-125 only covers packing and does not release the part to this plant. The customer of BR-310 is also not given. Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so a person must confirm whether a current release exists.
